in_marathi.name: Swaran
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who protects
in_marathi.long_meaning: Swaran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Swaran is a Sanskrit and Punjabi name derived from the Sanskrit word Swar, meaning one who protects. It is also associated with the Hindu deity Krishna, who is known as Swarana Bhagwan, the protector of the universe.
